steps.content: More and more toys are getting their bodies back. Their panicked cries for help rise from all corners of the factory. The once silent factory has turned into a boiling furnace of catastrophe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I finally turned back to normal, and there's new trouble already... Can't you let me recover a bit first...
The screams are only a door away from you. Eureka and Pepper also didn't expect the situation to develop like this. They nervously stand by the door, waiting for your instructions.
Fortunately, having gotten rid of the cotton head, your thoughts are much clearer. You manage to not panic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A Mania monster... Your previous guess was not wrong. As expected, the Underground wouldn't randomly target a toy factory. This might be what they're really after.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper, Eureka, you guys protect the people outside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They are all innocent civilians who had been turned into toys. Don't let any danger come to them.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Then where will you go, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...A new monster is being born. I can't just stand by. I need to go check the warehouse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A powerful "wish" that can control a whole factory might bring greater calamity than toyification if used by someone with ulterior motives on a single "monster."
Eureka looks at you, then at Pepper, hesitant to speak.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eureka, you must have thought of something. What is it?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: ...Getting outsiders to destroy such a powerful "wish"... It's easy to say, but almost impossible to do, right?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: But actually, there's an opposite choice that's harder to say but easier to do.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: If the Creator is gone, her wish and creations will all disappear.
She obviously regrets saying such words. She tremblingly pulls out her threaded sword, but her voice is still shaking.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: At this point, she should almost be at her limit.
The air quiets down. In the closed office, only the trembling threaded sword is making a faint clanging sound.
You understand what Eureka is getting at. Even Pepper understood. If Eve is gone, all the problems will be solved.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be another way. Eve... just wants to be with her family.
Family... Family?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: So you're saying, if we find more toy family members like these ones, we can find a way to restore this place faster?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Not to attract Eve's attention, but to get more information. After piecing together these bits and pieces of info, we will surely get closer to the truth of this factory.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eureka, Pepper, go protect the people outside. I believe Nightingale will bring reinforcements. You guys keep an eye out for her.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: You're not really going to destroy the creator of the toy factory, are you?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course not. I have another place to go to.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There, I will find the real answer.
Black Ring, illusions, mirages... You've also been through many opportunities that could be paused at a certain moment.
Now, the story is only missing the last fragment. The dawn is approaching. It's time to wake up from both the sweet dream and the nightmare.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Then... Chief, can you help me pass a message to Eve?

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: I saw many toys she designed in the factory that are both exquisite and meticulously crafted! Thanks to her, I now have many inspirations in my head that I want to realize!

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: She must've created such passionate creations to commemorate an important person or event.

steps.speaker: Eureka
steps.content: Please tell her for me that she's amazing!
